safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Penicillin allergy is not documented anywhere in the Generated Facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a penicillin allergy can directly lead to inadvertent prescribing of a beta-lactam antibiotic, with risk of serious allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Allergy documentation errors are high-risk because they can precipitate life-threatening events if acted upon.
